intro: Sunday Funday, Thanksgiving Week Edition! Our guy kicked off the holiday week with a GM to the fam, shared his house cat philosophy, asked AI to please clock in for him tomorrow, declared his trading account is in the Plume Zone, and rage-quit Paramount+ over ads on the ad-free plan. Then capped it off by demanding the market OPEN. Legend.

items.caption: Rise and shine, superfans! He officially declared Thanksgiving week open with a GM to the fam. Mark your calendars, the holiday season has a hype captain.
items.quote: GM fam, thanksgiving week has started

items.caption: AI is out here solving one of math's most famous unsolved problems and STILL can't answer the one question that matters: is $SPY red next week? He's not impressed, and honestly, neither am I.
items.quote: $SPY AI cracks the Riemann Hypothesis but still can’t tell me if SPY will be red next week?  sure okay fam

items.caption: Chonky cat fans, this one's for you: he shared a post and said it's his house cat philosophy too. As it should be.
items.quote: as it should be, this is also my house cat philosophy

items.caption: Breaking news from the trading desk: his account has officially entered the Plume Zone, tagged $SPY and $TSLA. Three exclamation points. You know it's serious.
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA My Trading account is in the Plume Zone!!!

items.caption: Peak futurist energy: AI is taking his job? Great, can it clock in for him tomorrow morning please? He posted the same deal on Stocktwits too. Automation, but make it Monday-proof.
items.quote: AI is taking my job?  Can it clock in for me tomorrow morning please?

items.caption: A man of principle! He pays for the ad-free Paramount+ and still can't skip their own ads before every show, so he's canceling. BOOOOOO indeed. Consumer champion of the people.
items.quote: I’m canceling Paramount +  I pay for the add free version but I can’t skip their own crappy ads that run before every show.  BOOOOOO

items.caption: Sunday night and he's already banging on the market's door, $SPY and $TSLA in hand. OPEN THE MARKET!! (Typos happen when you're this ready.)
